method: Within-round nearest-rank quantiles, paired round ratios and median of round quantiles. Empirical p99 is not a population-tail guarantee. No pooled-query significance claim.
limits: Local free synthetic development only; no paid APIs/cloud, models or model downloads.
The current revision contains many functional repairs; this comparison cannot causally attribute an aggregate timing change to one patch.
This is not a competitor benchmark, high-dimensional evaluation, hardware power-loss test, production latency guarantee or best-in-class claim.
Original October 29/31 measurements and their limits remain unchanged.

Complete result payloads are retained outside timed regions identically in each variant; this changes allocator history relative to the original harness. Compare new runs with each other, not directly with old absolute timing samples.
